title: Pure Strategy With Imperfect Information
body_html:
Pure Strategy With Imperfect Information

For player $i$ in an imperfect-information extensive game, a pure strategy is a function assigning to every information set $P^i_k$ an action $$ a_i\in A_i(P^i_k). $$ A pure strategy profile again induces a unique terminal outcome, so every finite extensive game has an associated normal form.
